dataset: Mumbai Historical Flood Observation Points, Extents, and Benchmark Event Records
source: Government of Maharashtra Chitale Committee Report / BMC Disaster Management Department / OpenCity / IIT Bombay Hydrology Lab
spatial_resolution: Point coordinates for chronic spots (< 5m accuracy); polygon boundary outlines for historical inundation zones
coverage: Mumbai Island City, Western Suburbs, Eastern Suburbs, Mithi River Basin
quality: high (Grounded in official government inquiry reports, engineering master plans, and municipal records)
limitations: News media reports were strictly excluded unless verified against municipal log sheets and official disaster records. Polygons represent macro-inundation envelopes during peak deluge.
processing: Structured into Point and Polygon GeoJSON collections with explicit fields for recorded depth, drainage basin, mitigation measures, and traffic impacts.
notes: Primary validation ground truth for calibrating 2D hydrodynamic overland flow models and training Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (STGNN).
